summary: Kyndryl Holdings filed an 8-K reporting a September 24, 2026 underwriting agreement with J.P. Morgan, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley for $600 million of 7.800% senior notes due 2029 and $400 million of 7.875% senior notes due 2032, sold under its existing Form S-3 shelf. Indentures were executed September 28, 2026 with Bank of New York Mellon Trust. The unsecured, unguaranteed notes rank pari passu with existing senior debt. Proceeds repay $700 million of 2.05% notes due October 2026 and revolver balances. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch refinancing spreads and leverage.
